description_full:
🌟 INTERNSHIP OPPORTUNITY ALERT! 🌟

Embark on a Journey of Learning and Exploration!

Join the Internship Program at Kantor Perwakilan BEI Jawa Barat and gain hands-on experience in various areas—including administrative and organizing tasks that support our daily operations. 🗂️📊

📅 Open until: Sunday, November 8, 2026

📩 Submit your documents to: kantorperwakilan.jawabarat@idx.co.id

Let’s grow, learn, and explore together! 🚀
